label: EXPLORATORY — not part of the pre-registered verdict (prereg 'No post-result changes')
note: There is no pronounced initial rise of 1 − F_Total. Three seeds show noise-level early bumps (≤ 0.006 above the first value). The decay over the full series has γ ≈ 0.08–0.10 (seed mean 0.089), close to the paper's 0.1. This is exploratory and does not change the verdict. INFERENCE / OPEN QUESTION: the paper's Fig. 4 axis starts at t = 1, and its rise peaks near t ≈ 20–25 (card A17), whereas our model starts at t = R0 + 1 = 21. The published rise may therefore happen while the founder recipes are being built, a phase IC-a does not simulate (ambiguity A1/A17). Only the authors can settle this.
